And after #MeToo broke, I realized how hungry people were for a framework to do this work in a way that feels whole and true, that centers the person harmed and shows what the way forward can be for everybody. 

And my tradition has such a framework.

It’s about systemic racism & the legacy of enslavement; sexual abuse in the wake of #MeToo; Indigenous land rights; medical malpractice & so much more. It’s about the very structure of the criminal justice system. It’s about who expects forgiveness when, why, for what.
